# resources/

Source images consumed by `@capacitor/assets` to generate the Android
launcher icons, adaptive icons, monochrome themed icons and splash screens.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are (re)generated by
`scripts/prepare-android-assets.mjs` from `src/assets/app-icon.png.asset.json`,
which is the Lovable CDN pointer for the official Vairagya "V" logo.

Local regeneration:

```bash
node scripts/prepare-android-assets.mjs
bunx @capacitor/assets generate --android \
  --iconBackgroundColor "#07050F" \
  --iconBackgroundColorDark "#07050F" \
  --splashBackgroundColor "#07050F" \
  --splashBackgroundColorDark "#07050F"
```

Outputs land under `android/app/src/main/res/` — commit them if you want the
APK build to skip regeneration.
